decision_recording.decisions_supplied_by: the named humans recorded below, transmitted verbatim through the ChatGPT operator path
decision_recording.transcribed_by: Claude, under the W14-E instruction of 2026-09-13; no value here was authored, defaulted or inferred
decision_recording.preparer_boundary_note: The preparer_boundary above forbids the preparer to FILL or FABRICATE a requested input. Neither happened: every value below was supplied verbatim by the operator instruction and is transcribed byte for byte.

what_this_decides: The identity and the product/legal authority of the NEW CUMULATIVE delivery run: it carries forward all six membership rows of the sealed historical plank run exlib2u-plank-release1-staged-v1 (3 exercise members + 3 alias members) AND adds the five new weight_time exercise identities, so the release is additive, not a replacement. One decision for the run, not one per entry.

database_effect_when_completed.mechanism: direct owner INSERT into public.exercise_catalog_import_runs, then direct owner INSERTs into public.exercise_catalog_run_items
database_effect_when_completed.controlled_function: none exists for run creation; only exlib_approve_and_seal_run updates an existing run
database_effect_when_completed.authority: table owner (postgres) in the hosted operator context
database_effect_when_completed.when_the_evidence_is_written: AT CREATION, in the run INSERT. This is derived from the promoted staged-run package docs/exlib2u-staged-run-package.sql, not assumed: exlib_approve_and_seal_run only VALIDATES the product/legal evidence, it never populates it. That is why run staging cannot proceed without this form.
database_effect_when_completed.constraint_that_enforces_completeness: exercise_catalog_import_runs_approval_audit_chk requires, whenever approved_for_delivery is true, that product_approved_by, product_approved_at, legal_approved_by, legal_approved_at and approval_rationale are all present and non-blank AND dry_run is false.

preparer_boundary: Claude and ChatGPT may prepare and validate this form but may NEVER fill or fabricate any requested input. Where this form records a preparer_proposal, that is a derivation offered for confirmation and the corresponding value stays null.
no_effect_statement: Blank or null NEVER reads as approval. A run cannot be created from this form until it is completed by the operator, and creating the run still does not deliver anything: delivery additionally requires the seal and a production configuration change.

run_key_literal.constraint: 8 to 200 characters after btrim; UNIQUE across exercise_catalog_import_runs FOREVER; the SAME string is later bound by the seal call exlib_approve_and_seal_run(run_key) and by the runtime delivery configuration CATALOG_DELIVERY_RUN_KEY - choose it as a permanent, meaningful release identifier
run_key_literal.preparer_proposal_derivation: Mirrors the one promoted run key segment for segment: <staging milestone>-<subject>-release<N>-staged-v<M>, where exlib2u-plank-release1-staged-v1 is the precedent. Here the staging milestone is the W14 endgame, the subject is weight-time, it is the first release of that subject, and it is v1. Length 35, within the 8..200 constraint.
run_key_literal.must_not_be_reason: That key identifies the already-sealed plank release. Reuse is structurally impossible because run_key is UNIQUE, and the governing instruction named this a high-risk boundary.

product_approver_identity.constraint: a named human, non-blank after btrim; written to product_approved_by
product_approver_identity.product_approved_at_constraint: an explicit TIMESTAMPTZ with offset, supplied by the human; never generated, never defaulted to NOW()

legal_approver_identity.constraint: a named human, non-blank after btrim; written to legal_approved_by
legal_approver_identity.legal_approved_at_constraint: an explicit TIMESTAMPTZ with offset, supplied by the human; never generated, never defaulted to NOW()

approval_rationale.value: I approve `w14e-weight-time-release1-staged-v1` with the cumulative historical six plus five weight_time membership because it preserves the existing release while adding the five reviewed exercises; this approval does not itself enable production delivery.
approval_rationale.constraint: non-blank after btrim; written to approval_rationale. The promoted precedent states plainly what the approval does NOT authorize, and the same discipline is expected here: creating and sealing a run is not the same as enabling production delivery.

run_membership.choices_note: Only one choice is offered because the independent review (finding R-E1) fixes the membership: the new run must carry forward EXACTLY the six membership rows of the historical plank run (copied from that run, never retyped) plus EXACTLY the five W14 identities, and no carry. The field exists so the membership is affirmatively chosen rather than silently assumed.
run_membership.constraint: exactly 8 exercise members and 3 alias members (11 rows): the historical run's 3 exercise + 3 alias members copied from its own membership rows, plus the five new identities resolved by logical_id AND is_active = true

carried_forward_from_historical_run.source: the promoted docs/exlib2u-staged-run-package.sql membership postcondition; the stage-6 package copies the rows from the live historical run and refuses unless they resolve to exactly these six lines
carried_forward_from_historical_run.historical_run_untouched: the historical run is never mutated, revoked or edited; its membership is permanent

what_the_seal_will_independently_recheck.consequence: A family A snapshot decision left without a rationale will not fail at stage 1; it will fail here, at stage 7, after four intervening packages have run. That is why the snapshot form insists on a non-blank rationale per identity.
what_the_seal_will_independently_recheck.empty_membership: refused - 'an empty membership cannot be sealed'
what_the_seal_will_independently_recheck.already_sealed: refused - the seal is explicitly one-use
what_the_seal_will_independently_recheck.dry_run: refused - and dry_run is immutable once sealed, which is why the run is created with dry_run = false

permanence_warning.sealed_at: set exactly once and NEVER cleared
permanence_warning.membership: PERMANENT after the seal. exlib_freeze_run_membership refuses any insert or delete once the parent run is sealed, and refuses every UPDATE of a membership row unconditionally.
permanence_warning.consequence: A membership mistake discovered after sealing cannot be repaired. It requires a NEW run with a NEW permanent key, and the mistaken run stays in the table forever.
permanence_warning.revocation: possible but ONE-WAY, and only on a sealed run. It shuts a run down; it does not fix it.

what_this_form_does_not_authorize.delivery: Creating and sealing a run does NOT deliver anything. Delivery is a per-user RPC gated on auth.uid() and selected by the CATALOG_DELIVERY_RUN_KEY configuration value.
what_this_form_does_not_authorize.configuration_change: Repointing CATALOG_DELIVERY_RUN_KEY is a SEPARATE operator act with its own consequences, set out in docs/weight-time-five-entry-delivery-configuration-dependency.md. Claude has not performed it and has had no Vercel contact.
what_this_form_does_not_authorize.the_plank_release: Nothing in this form modifies, revokes or supersedes the existing sealed plank run. Its six membership rows are CARRIED FORWARD into the new cumulative run; the historical rows stay untouched.

open_reviewer_questions: RQ-6: confirm or replace the proposed run key literal. It is permanent and globally unique, so it is worth a deliberate choice rather than acceptance of a default.

RQ-7: the promoted precedent had the same named human give both product and legal approval, at the same timestamp. That is lawful (the constraint requires two non-blank identities, not two distinct ones). Confirm whether the same posture is intended here or whether a second approver is now expected.

RQ-8: the sealed plank run remains sealed and approved regardless of what happens here. The intent (review finding R-E1) is to ADD a second sealed CUMULATIVE run that carries the historical six forward plus the five, and later repoint delivery to it; revocation of the plank run is one-way and is not prepared. See F-E8 in the report before any repoint: the committed delivery function refuses the cumulative run for users who already received Plank from the historical run.
